{{Quote|Is there something you'd like me to make for you? I have digitalized holoscrap of every imaginable background, face, animal, and bit of furniture that's ever been recorded: motions, sounds, the slightest variations of movements. You would not know that you weren't there.|Liegeus Vorn|<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
A '''holo faker''' was one who falsified [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] by piecing together holographic footage, usually for personal gain. Many holo fakers got their start as children, playing pranks via their creations. Holo fakers generally maintained a large database of holographic recordings from which to draw material for their works.
